not_acquired.am3c05481.pdf: The publisher's own article PDF (JATS self-uri). On pubs.acs.org it sits behind a Cloudflare bot check that this run is forbidden to use a browser against. It was NOT needed: the PMC JATS record carries the complete body text, both main-text tables as structured <table> markup, and every figure caption, which is strictly better than a text layer extracted from a PDF.
